746740101.text: Ancient Iron Coins... Ancient Iron Coins... Nice, very nice!

746740102.text: #With so many Ancient Iron Coins, I'm sure I can make a pretty pile of Mora! Thanks a ton, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

746740103.text: What do you plan on doing next?

746740104.text: Of course, I'm going to... think of a way to exchange these Ancient Iron Coins for Mora, or other convenient and useful items.

746740105.text: But seriously, I really don't want to get tangled up with that middleman from before. He takes a huge cut every time.

746740106.text: Not only that, but it takes forever for him to get my money to me. I haven't got a clue what he's doing...

746740107.text: But... Other than him, I simply can't find anyone reliable to work with... *sigh*

746740108.text: Enough of that! These are for you, consider it a bonus for our fruitful long-term cooperation.

746740109.text: Once my business here in Fontaine is over, I'll need to think carefully about my next steps. I can't just keep traveling, that's way too tiring...
